## BStringItem  
  
A [`BStringItem`](BStringItem.md "BStringItem") is a container for text that you want to display as an item in a [`BListView`](BListView.md "BListView"). To use a [`BStringItem`](BStringItem.md "BStringItem"), you construct it, set its text (either in the constructor or through [`SetText()`](BStringItem.md#BStringItem_SetText "SetText\(\), Text\(\)")) and then add it to a [`BListView`](BListView.md "BListView") object.
